remarks: Bayside Spanish-style duplex on the Peninsula, just one house from the sand. Both units have been completely renovated and come fully furnished with tasteful, beach-ready furnishings. The upstairs 2 bed / 1 bath unit is a highly rated short-term rental. The downstairs is a 2 bed / 2 bath. Finishes include exposed wood-beam ceilings, quartz countertops, wood-tone cabinetry, stainless appliances including a professional-style range, frameless glass showers with designer tile, French doors, and custom closet built-ins. Each unit has its own private patio. A 2-car garage and a separate laundry room next to it round out a coastal income property steps from the beach and bay.
